== English Decipher comparison ==
The Glossary broadens the piloting bonus. Free deployment still requires your Independent starship. The 2023 Appendix A PDF contains the Independent icon, which its plain-text extraction omits. Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=129 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 129. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=5 Decipher Errata], PDF page 5. Players Committee, 2023, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=131 Advanced Rulebook, Appendix A], PDF page 131.
